name: 99ribu-console
source: Copy of the admin-dashboard house default (volum-default) because the staff console already measures to it. Baseline measured 2026-11-02 with a signed-in synthetic owner at 390, 1366 and 1536 px on routes /admin, pesanan, produk, produk/sku, produk/inventori, keuangan, pengaturan, pengaturan/staf, produk/baru. Proposed by DEC-026; becomes the accepted contract when the owner accepts DEC-026.

measured.button heights: 32, 36 on desktop; 50 to 132 on a phone are full-width buttons
measured.sidebar: 256 expanded; the 64 px tablet rail was not in this measurement
measured.radius: 6 and 8, plus 32 on circular avatars and chips

deviations: Tablet rail is 64 px (4rem, for 44 px targets plus padding) instead of 48 px: src/app/admin/(console)/admin.css `[data-slot=admin-sidebar]`.

Spec 10 line 78 gives a 28/36 weight-600 page title on desktop; the console renders 24/700 (house default). Recommended: amend spec 10 to the measured value because the title must stay larger than the KPI value and density matters. Owner decision O-1 in DESIGN.md.
The sidebar is a custom component (`data-slot=admin-sidebar`), not the shadcn Sidebar, so the sidebar-width selector below targets it.
notes.not_measurable_with_the_script: admin-geometry.mjs has no sign-in option, so signed-in routes are reported 'not checked' by the script. Use the Playwright baseline in BUILD-LOG (2026-11-02) or add a sign-in option to the script before relying on it.
